what_happens: Seed, fertilizer, fuel, feed and machinery reach the farm
s2_notes: Livestock add feed, fencing and veterinary inputs
source: USDA ERS Fertilizer Use and Price; NASS Agricultural Chemical Use; ERS ARMS
in_report: Partly (N rates assumed; ISU/ERS cost budgets)

what_happens: Crops grown and livestock raised on each field or pasture
source: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer; Quick Stats; Census of Agriculture; Crop Sequence Boundaries

what_happens: Grain stored in bins and trucked; animals hauled
s2_notes: Hay stored on farm; wool bagged; apples need cold storage
source: USDA NASS Grain Stocks; USDA AMS Grain Transportation Report

what_happens: Elevator, processor, ethanol plant, sale barn or wool pool buys the raw product
s2_notes: Sale barns, hay auctions, wool co-op, fresh markets
source: IDALS licensing lists; USDA AMS Market News; Iowa RFA; Tradeverifyd

what_happens: Rail, barge or truck to processors, feedlots, river and export terminals
source: BTS/ORNL Freight Analysis Framework (FAF5); STB Carload Waybill Sample

what_happens: Wet and dry milling, soybean crushing, ethanol, oat milling, meatpacking
s2_notes: Packing plants, wool scouring, cider and fruit packing
source: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program; NASS Grain Crushings; EIA ethanol capacity; NASS Livestock Slaughter

what_happens: Starch, sweeteners, oils, meal, feed, fuel and foods made by downstream firms
s2_notes: Meat, textiles, fresh and processed fruit
source: Tradeverifyd trade relationships; Census County Business Patterns (NAICS 311)

what_happens: Products shipped to domestic distributors or exported
s2_notes: Mostly domestic and regional for new products
source: USDA FAS GATS; UN Comtrade (via Tradeverifyd); Census USA Trade Online

what_happens: Grocery stores, restaurants and fuel stations sell to the public
source: USDA ERS Food Dollar Series; ERS Food Price Outlook; BLS Consumer Price Index

what_happens: Food eaten, fuel burned, fiber worn
s2_notes: Per-capita demand limits for lamb, goat and apples
source: USDA ERS Food Availability (Per Capita) Data System
